name: inbucket-e56c6d5f-blind30-ots
instr:
# Mail-capture server: thirty regressions to find without a test suite

This software takes in mail that other programs push at it and lets us read that mail back afterwards, and it now gets things wrong from the moment mail arrives through to the moment someone looks at it. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits. Nothing about the protocols changed and nothing about our own setup changed. What follows is what we saw from the outside, roughly in the order we ran into it.

Offering mail to it in the first place. Greeting works, and most malformed sender commands are still turned away with a 501, but a sender command carrying a trailing parameter whose value is not a number — a size given as 147KB — is now waved through instead of drawing the 501 complaint. Told to refuse everything by default and given a short list of the two domains it may take, it takes mail for a domain that is not on that list; the mirror-image setup, accepting by default with a small deny list, still turns away exactly what it should. A recipient whose local part — the run of characters before the @ — is exactly 128 characters long is now called malformed, while a single character is still fine and 129 is still refused.
